identityLock: Vox-inspired editorial paper-collage elements with soft 2.5D rendering, tactile torn-paper cutout shapes, rounded forms, satin-matte surfaces, subtle white highlights, and crisp imperfect black marker doodles. Palette: hot pink #F02A55, rose pink #F25A74, soft blush paper #F9DCD9, ink black #0F0D0D, soft white #FFFDFC. Background: solid clean chroma green #00FF66 with no texture, no gradient, and no extra objects.

jobs.prompt: Create one isolated high-impact thumbnail element: a sleek black shipping box labeled 'COOLMATE' surrounded by shiny pink profit badges, contrasted on the right side by a crumpled soft blush paper return shipping label with black marker smoke doodles. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.

Create an isolated glossy paper-art badge sticker showing '30%' in bright pastel pink font with directional black doodle arrows pointing upward. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.

Create one clean 3:4 cutout sheet with two separate isolated elements: top, a floating 3D white paper megaphone with a hot pink banner; bottom, a dramatic white award badge with an ink black strike-through mark. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.

Create an isolated sad cardboard delivery box stamped with a large hot pink 'RETURNED' stamp and a frowning black customer icon sticker. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.
Create an isolated robotic hand holding a hot pink warning flag with an exclamation mark. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.
Create an isolated open gift box filled with neatly folded black apparel and a pink ribbon. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.

Create one clean 3:4 studio cutout sheet with three separate isolated elements: top, a neat white folder labeled 'SCRIPT' in black ink; middle, a folded black polo shirt; bottom, a white checkmark badge with a soft pink ribbon. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.
Create an isolated paper-art graphic of two hands shaking in agreement with floating pink hearts around them. Background perfectly uniform solid chroma key green #00FF66, flat and shadowless.
